decision: Replace ManualCopyAdapter for ChannelType.vk with VkAdapter that posts text via wall.post using community access token + group_id. MVP = text only. Photo / photo+text = phase 2 (out of this design's implementation scope). UI: add vk to MVP_CHANNELS connect form (group_id + access_token + pdn). Plan picker may include vk for social_post. Test community: club241074885 (group_id 241074885).

inputs_confirmed.auth: community key (TZ §13.3), not VK ID OAuth

C4.external_system: VK API api.vk.com (wall.post, groups.getById health probe)
flows: User/Web -> API POST channels/vk/credentials (token+group_id) -> Postgres ciphertext
User/Web -> API POST channel health -> VkAdapter.health -> api.vk.com
Beat -> Worker publish_due -> VkAdapter.publish -> wall.post -> wall URL stored on Publication
assumptions: Same ChannelAccount + Fernet pattern as Telegram/Gmail.
api.vk.com reachable from VPS without proxy (unlike local Telegram SOCKS).
constraints: Do not store plaintext token in meta or GET responses.
open_questions: Exact health method: groups.getById vs wall.get — prefer groups.getById (read, low side effect).

processes: P-pub: publish text to community wall
P-manual-fallback: on permanent capability/auth failure surface manual_copy (existing)
flows: User -> P-cred: access_token, group_id, pdn_consent, display_name
assumptions: Variant primary text field for social_post is sufficient message body.
constraints: Empty message without attachments → do not call wall.post; fail validation.
open_questions: Max text length clamp: use VK limit ~16384 or AdapterLimits — pick conservative 4096 like Telegram unless tests say otherwise.

uc_connect: API save_credentials -> encrypt token, meta.group_id, status=connected
uc_publish_text: Plan/Editor produces social_post variant scheduled to vk channel
Beat marks due -> Worker claims Publication
POST wall.post owner_id=-group_id from_group=1 message=text guid=idempotency_key
On auth/access denied: non-retryable; channel may flip error
On empty text: validation failed non-retryable
uc_phase2_photo_deferred: Future: upload photo -> attachments -> wall.post message+attachments
assumptions: guid = publication idempotency_key to reduce duplicate posts within 1h VK window.
constraints: No photo path in MVP sequences.
open_questions: Whether mark-manual remains available as user escape hatch (yes — keep existing manual_copy UI for failures).

POST /api/v1/brands/{brand_id}/channels/.changes: Require group_id for vk (today optional) — design decision: 422 if missing/non-numeric. Strip spaces on token.

existing.POST /api/v1/channels/{id}/health: Live VkAdapter.health instead of ciphertext-only for vk
existing.GET channels: public meta may include group_id; never access_token

assumptions: Credentials route already wired; harden validation only.
constraints: No VK App ID/Secret in env for MVP community key path.

Migration_plan.data: Existing vk ChannelAccount rows (if any) stay; until token+group_id valid they health-fail. No auto-migrate.
Migration_plan.ui_flag: Add vk to MVP_CHANNELS alongside telegram,gmail
Migration_plan.rollback: Point get_adapter(vk) back to ManualCopyAdapter; hide vk from MVP_CHANNELS
assumptions: Prod has zero or few vk rows.

Security_notes.secrets: Fernet token_ciphertext; redact token in logs/errors via redact_secret
Security_notes.ssrf: Fixed host api.vk.com only — no user-controlled URL
Security_notes.token_leak: Never echo VK error messages that embed token
assumptions: Community key treated as high-value secret equal to TG bot token
constraints: Do not log full wall.post response if it could contain sensitive fields

NFR.reliability: Reuse publish retry policy (1/5/15 then dead) for retryable VK errors
NFR.observability: Log vk_wall_post ok/fail with group_id and error code only
constraints: Text MVP must not call photo upload APIs

phase2_backlog: Photo upload path; validate community token photo capabilities (error 27 risk)
stats.get / post metrics if scopes allow
Optional VK ID app — only if community key path insufficient

consistency_check.C4_DFD_Sequence: All describe community key text wall.post only; photo deferred
consistency_check.TZ_13_3: aligned (community wall.post, token in credentials, rate_limited, manual fallback)
consistency_check.test_community: club241074885 / 241074885 documented as smoke target, not hardcoded in product
